readme:
## Overview

This module provides a framework for authentication/authorization based on the Basic Authentication scheme specified in [RFC 7617](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7617).

The Basic Authentication scheme transmits credentials as user-id/password pairs encoded using Base64. This scheme is not considered to be a secure method of user authentication unless used in conjunction with some external secure system such as TLS as the user ID and password are passed over the network as cleartext.

The Ballerina `auth` module facilitates auth providers that are to be used by the clients and listeners of different protocol connectors.

### Listener file user store Basic Auth provider

Represents the file user store based listener Basic Auth provider, which is used to authenticate the provided credentials against the provided file user store configurations. The users are denoted by a section in the `Config.toml` file. The username, password, and the scopes of a particular user are denoted as keys under the `users` section as shown below. For multiple users, the complete section has to be duplicated.

```toml
[[ballerina.auth.users]]
username="alice"
password="xxx"
scopes=["read", "write"]
```

### Listener LDAP user store Basic Auth provider

Represents the LDAP-based listener Basic Auth provider, which is used to authenticate the provided credentials against the provided LDAP user store configurations. This connects to an active directory or an LDAP, which retrieves the necessary user information and performs authentication and authorization.

### Client Basic Auth provider

Represents the client Basic Auth provider, which is used to authenticate with an external endpoint by generating a Basic Auth token against the provided credential configurations.

typeDefs.name: UserDetails
typeDefs.description: Represents the details of the authenticated user.

fields.name: username
fields.description: The username of the authenticated user

fields.name: scopes
fields.description: The scopes of the authenticated user

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description:
Represents the error type of the module. This will be returned if an error occurred while any of the listener
Basic Auth providers try to authenticate the received credentials and client Basic Auth providers try to generate
the token.

typeDefs.name: CredentialsConfig
typeDefs.description: Represents credentials for Basic Auth authentication.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Username for Basic Auth authentication

fields.name: password
fields.description: Password for Basic Auth authentication

typeDefs.name: ListenerBasicAuthProvider
typeDefs.description:
Represents the listener Basic Auth provider, which could be used to authenticate credentials.
The `auth:ListenerBasicAuthProvider` acts as the interface for all the Basic Auth listener authentication providers.
Any type of implementation such as file store, LDAP user store, in memory user store, JDBC user store etc. should be
object-wise similar.

typeDefs.name: FileUserStoreConfig
typeDefs.description: Represents the file user store configurations.

typeDefs.name: LdapUserStoreConfig
typeDefs.description: Represents the LDAP user store configurations.

fields.name: domainName
fields.description: Unique name to identify the user store

fields.name: connectionUrl
fields.description: Connection URL of the LDAP server

fields.name: connectionName
fields.description: The username used to connect to the LDAP server

fields.name: connectionPassword
fields.description: The password used to connect to the LDAP server

fields.name: userSearchBase
fields.description: DN of the context or object under which the user entries are stored in the LDAP server

fields.name: userEntryObjectClass
fields.description: Object class used to construct user entries

fields.name: userNameAttribute
fields.description: The attribute used for uniquely identifying a user entry

fields.name: userNameSearchFilter
fields.description: Filtering criteria used to search for a particular user entry

fields.name: userNameListFilter
fields.description: Filtering criteria for searching user entries in the LDAP server

fields.name: groupSearchBase
fields.description: DN of the context or object under which the group entries are stored in the LDAP server

fields.name: groupEntryObjectClass
fields.description: Object class used to construct group entries

fields.name: groupNameAttribute
fields.description: The attribute used for uniquely identifying a group entry

fields.name: groupNameSearchFilter
fields.description: Filtering criteria used to search for a particular group entry

fields.name: groupNameListFilter
fields.description: Filtering criteria for searching group entries in the LDAP server

fields.name: membershipAttribute
fields.description: Define the attribute, which contains the distinguished names (DN) of user objects that are there in a group

fields.name: userRolesCacheEnabled
fields.description: To indicate whether to cache the role list of a user

fields.name: connectionPoolingEnabled
fields.description: Define whether LDAP connection pooling is enabled

fields.name: connectionTimeout
fields.description: Connection timeout (in seconds) when making the initial LDAP connection

fields.name: readTimeout
fields.description: Reading timeout (in seconds) for LDAP operations

fields.name: secureSocket
fields.description: The SSL configurations for the LDAP client socket. This needs to be configured in order to communicate through LDAPs

fields.name: cert
fields.description: Configurations associated with the `crypto:TrustStore` or single certificate file that the client trusts

typeDefs.name: ClientBasicAuthProvider
typeDefs.description: Provides authentication based on the provided Basic Auth configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Provides authentication based on the provided Basic Auth configurations.

functions.name: generateToken
functions.description:
Generates a Base64-encoded token for Basic Auth authentication.
```ballerina
string token = check provider.generateToken();
```

return.description: The generated token or else an `auth:Error` if an error occurred

typeDefs.name: ListenerFileUserStoreBasicAuthProvider
typeDefs.description: Provides authentication based on the provided configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Provides authentication based on the provided configurations.

functions.name: authenticate
functions.description:
Authenticate the Base64-encoded `username:password` credentials.
```ballerina
auth:UserDetails result = check provider.authenticate("<credential>");
```

return.description: `auth:UserDetails` if the authentication is successful or else an `auth:Error` if an error occurred

typeDefs.name: ListenerLdapUserStoreBasicAuthProvider
typeDefs.description: Creates an LDAP auth store with the provided configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Creates an LDAP auth store with the provided configurations.

functions.name: authenticate
functions.description:
Attempts to authenticate the Base64-encoded `username:password` credentials.
```ballerina
auth:UserDetails result = check provider.authenticate("<credential>");
```

return.description: `auth:UserDetails` if the authentication is successful or else an `auth:Error` if an error occurred

functions.name: extractUsernameAndPassword
functions.description:
Extracts the username and the password from the Base64-encoded `username:password` value.
```ballerina
[string, string] [username, password] = check auth:extractUsernameAndPassword("<credential>");
```

return.description: A `string` tuple with the extracted username and password or else an `auth:Error` if an error occurred
